text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock B to secure gains, then bought it back at higher prices; I should let my investment plan, not the urge to lock in a win, guide exits and reentries.","I should not cling to a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake, or sell a sound holding merely because it is profitable; assess each stock's prospects from today's price.","My account rose overall despite monthly setbacks, and frequent checking can prompt unnecessary trades. I should review the whole portfolio, manage risk, and act only when new evidence changes my decision."]}
